defaults.fresh_setup: All eight supplied policies enabled, including Batteries and Vacuums; six named notifications, no delivery methods or destinations; sending off.

defaults.existing_installations: Preserve enabled, disabled and deleted policies, edits, notification assignments, destinations and sending; checked through setup and two reloads in both storage locations with sending on and off.

upgrade_protection.supported_conversion: Recognized older named-notification settings gain zero collection delay, preserving timing and other saved choices. Conversion is written only after successful restoration and evaluation.
upgrade_protection.unsupported_state: Actual synthetic presented and queued snapshots from published Homeostatic 1.9.0 / health-tree 0.8.0 predate collection tracking and are rejected before writes or sends. Original settings and history remain intact; recovery requires the matching prior installation or paired backup.
upgrade_protection.failed_restore: Invalid engine, policy, temperature and UPS state remains intact through retries, unload and another setup, with no partial conversion or notification requests. Malformed monitor maps fail before startup.
upgrade_protection.retained_delivery: Supported current state retains history, acknowledgment, pauses, stable pending delivery identities and resolved destinations through reload.
upgrade_protection.packaged_rehearsal: Fresh packaged HA setup verifies defaults, then converts customized earlier settings with a disabled Battery policy, deleted notification presets and a captured-only destination; repeated reloads preserve the expected settings.
upgrade_protection.future_release_rule: AGENTS.md and development-workflows.md require preserving migrations, published-format scenarios, repeated reload and failed-restore protection; no reset to make an upgrade load.
